policy.external_artifacts_rule: Datasets, reasoning traces, model weights, and external SDKs require a separate license review by authorized human maintainers before production deployment or redistribution.
policy.governance_boundary: AI agents may recommend, flag conflicts, estimate value, and prepare plans, but must not redefine voting rules, authorize treasury spending, or declare their own experiments valid.

artifacts.name: examples/grpo_reasoning
artifacts.notes: Clean-room Apache-2.0 pure Python stdlib implementation and test suite.

artifacts.name: examples/grpo_reasoning/dataset.py (deterministic procedural split)
artifacts.notes: Procedurally generated deterministic arithmetic, symbolic logic, and code-trace tasks with zero third-party copyrighted text.

artifacts.name: huggingface/trl (GRPOConfig / GRPOTrainer)
artifacts.notes: Current maintained RLHF/GRPO library integrated with Zoo Gym (src/gym/utils/schemas/trl.py).

artifacts.name: volcengine/verl (Ray GRPO)
artifacts.notes: Current maintained scalable Ray-based RL post-training framework supporting GRPO and Schulman k3 low-variance KL.

artifacts.name: open-thoughts/OpenThoughts-114k
artifacts.notes: Openly licensed reasoning trace dataset; trace provenance and teacher-model terms require separate human legal review prior to production weight release.

artifacts.name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
artifacts.notes: Pinned small base model candidate for GPU GRPO reproduction; exact commit revision must be verified by maintainers before production release.

artifacts.name: zenlm/zen-1.5b-instruct
artifacts.notes: Zen open-weight family candidate; pin exact checkpoint hash before production runs.

artifacts.name: huggingface/open-r1
artifacts.notes: Upstream repository explicitly states it is no longer maintained. Excluded from all training recipes, imports, and dependencies.
